project.name: MD2PDF
project.description: Web app that loads/edits Markdown and renders it live as paginated A4-style pages with KaTeX math support
project.author: Philip Leichauer

fromProjectPlan: Current scope: small engineering, report and academic Markdown documents
Browser-only authoring, local workspace autosave and portable ZIP packages
HTML KaTeX math and optional lazy visual equation editor; no SVG mode
Paginated portrait paper, output checks and native browser Save as PDF
No backend, full TeX compiler, bibliography engine or thesis project workflow
Historical ProjectPlan.md retained; docs/USE_CASES.md and docs/CODE_REVIEW.md describe current behaviour
